title: ALL ( table ) as a CALCULATE modifier removes the filters on the table
query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS ( 'Product'[Color], "All products", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ALL ( 'Product' ) ) )

source.quote: Removes all filters from the specified table.
source.supports: ALL ( Table ) removes all filters from the table

source.quote: when used as a CALCULATE filter, removes a filter. It does not return a table result.
source.supports: as a CALCULATE filter ALL removes filters

derivation: The color filter of each row is on a column of Product; ALL ( Product ) removes it. Grand total 540 on each of the three rows (Green too, as its value is not blank).
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
